interactionModel: Pure Foldkit view + pure ChartInteractionState. Rm3ChartConfig gained optional theme and interaction (hiddenSeriesIds, tooltip, onToggleSeries, onShowPoint, onHideTooltip). Legend entries are buttons dispatching ToggleSeries; point circles dispatch ShowPoint on click/mouse-enter and carry an exact aria-label plus SVG <title>; a selected point renders a data-chart-tooltip overlay. Hidden series are removed from both SVG and the accessible table while their legend entry remains toggleable.
tokenMechanism: chartInteractionState.requestToken is monotonic per chart instance. SwitchRange increments it and returns a ChartRangeCommand {type:'LoadChartRange', token, range}; RangeLoaded applies only when token === state.requestToken, otherwise the state/series are returned unchanged. No global ids/module state.

constraints: Pure SVG only; no ECharts, canvas, dependency, host, wrapper, root, lockfile, vendor or private change. No client app file was needed because the range Command lives in the UI interaction module.
unproven: The interaction model is a pure/Scene proof, not a browser pointer/keyboard session; resize behavior and the real page's range loader wiring are outside this slice.
